scripts.build:tokens: cd ../.. && pnpm exec style-dictionary build --config packages/tokens/config.js
scripts.copy-tokens: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const dir=p.resolve(__dirname,'../../packages/tokens/build/css');const dst=p.resolve(__dirname,'src');fs.copyFileSync(p.join(dir,'variables.css'),p.join(dst,'tokens-variables.css'));fs.copyFileSync(p.join(dir,'theme.css'),p.join(dst,'tokens-theme.css'));console.log('copied tokens css -> src/')"
scripts.build:css: pnpm run copy-shared && pnpm run build:tokens && pnpm run build:uno
scripts.dev:css: pnpm run copy-shared && pnpm run build:tokens && pnpm run dev:uno
